description: This file defines a service class 'CancelTransactionFromExternalAssetOwnerHandler' that handles commands for canceling transactions from external asset owners within the Fineract project. It implements processing logic by delegating to a write service.

classes.name: CancelTransactionFromExternalAssetOwnerHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles cancel transaction commands related to external asset owners, implementing command processing by invoking a write service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JsonCommand to cancel an external asset owner transaction by delegating to the externalAssetOwnersWriteService.
